subject: Social Media
title: The Small World Problem
description: Learn The Small World Problem in one minute.

hook.text: Stanley Milgram proved in 1967 that any two Americans are connected by about six handshakes.

buildup.text: Six degrees of separation means information can theoretically reach anyone on Earth in six hops.

discovery.text: Facebook found its users averaged 3.57 degrees of separation. The world shrank since Milgram's era.

twist.text: Fewer degrees means faster spread. A rumor can reach billions in hours—far faster than any broadcast.

climax.text: The small world effect makes both good ideas and dangerous lies spread at the same terrifying speed.

punchline.text: The world got smaller. That's not always good.

quiz.question: What did Facebook find about degrees of separation among its users?
